resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a standard biometric update when every de-duplication candidate matched on face but was adjudicated a false positive, and none of those false positives came from the resident's own parent Aadhaar.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a biometric update, which must authenticate against their own parent Aadhaar. The candidate set consisted entirely of face-matching records from other parents that were all discounted as false positives, so the update was blocked by matches carrying no real duplicate. Once those false-positive candidates are settled the packet can be replayed without resident involvement.
